decisions.reason: The weir dimensioning web tool costs little to maintain, supports engineering planners in the core flood-control business, and generates leads for the new weir products D and F.
With the related automation product A already withdrawn, the fouling detection system is at risk, but it ties into the energy recovery strategy and likely R&D funding, so it stays for now.
The spring-controlled flap weir is newly launched hardware close to the core flood-control portfolio and needs time to win municipal projects.
Energy management for water facilities fits the firm's digital networking and efficiency strategy and current utility demand.
The overflow flap gate line has its own web page and several models, which signals a core product with ongoing commitment.
